properties.name: design_regions costs ~109 × 5 s because it calls scope_region once per Project and Component — the walk is rebuilt from scratch for every seed
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-09-11, closing the open half of `fact:design-regions-exceeds-300-seconds-and-wedges-the-shared-server`, which recorded the symptom and stated plainly that where the time went was NOT measured.

THE SHAPE, read from `regions.rs:170`: for every Project and Component the design has, `design_regions` calls `scope_region(seed, depth)` and then filters the gap, defect and claim lists against that region. The three rollups are hoisted correctly and paid once. **The walk is not.**

    one scoped region walk            5,173 ms   (detect_gaps with scope+depth:1)
    seeds on this design                  109   (1 Project + 108 Components)
    implied                            ~545 s
    observed                           >300 s twice, >150 s again today

⭐ SO IT IS NOT A SLOW GRAPH, IT IS N WALKS OF ONE. The same graph answers `get_node` in 3 ms and `detect_gaps` in 3.9 s. Nothing about the question requires rebuilding the walk per seed — the graph does not change between seeds, only which node it starts from — which is the identical argument `con:a-sweep-builds-its-network-a-fixed-number-of-times` already makes for `detect_defects`: *"the network has to be constructed once and interrogated N times; nothing about the question requires reconstructing it per candidate."* That Constraint exists, is accepted, and does not cover this tool.

🛑 NOT ESTABLISHED, and it bounds the fix rather than the diagnosis: whether the 5,173 ms is the adjacency build, the traversal, or the per-node store reads inside it; and whether a shared structure can serve 109 different start nodes without changing what a region MEANS (`dec:the-default-scope-depth-should-be-two` records that "a region" already has two definitions that were once described as one — so a shared walk must not quietly merge them). A debug binary was used; `fact:every-cost-number-today-was-a-debug-build...` measures the profile alone at 2.2x, and 2.2x does not rescue 545 s.

NOT FIXED HERE. Recorded so the next increment starts from the cause rather than the symptom.
